title: A Locally Robust Semiparametric Approach to Examiner IV Designs
abstract: arXiv:2404.19144v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: I propose a locally robust semiparametric framework for estimating causal effects using examiner IV designs when adjustment for many or continuous covariates makes saturation infeasible or produces sparse cells. The key ingredient of this approach is an orthogonal moment function that removes the first-order effect of estimation errors in the two treatment regressions defining the examiner IV. I derive the orthogonal moment function and show that it remains valid under misspecification when, for each treatment regression, either that regression or the corresponding Riesz representer in the influence function adjustment is correctly specified. The proposed framework not only allows estimation of the examiner IV using a wide range of nonparametric and machine learning techniques, including LASSO, neural networks and random forests, but also delivers root-$n$ consistent estimation and valid inference under suitable regularity conditions

translated_title: 考官工具变量设计的局部稳健半参数方法
translated_abstract: 当对大量或连续协变量的调整使得饱和处理不可行或产生稀疏单元格时，我提出了一个局部稳健的半参数框架，用于通过考官工具变量设计估计因果效应。该方法的关键要素是一个正交矩函数，它消除了定义考官工具变量的两个处理回归中估计误差的一阶效应。我推导出了该正交矩函数，并证明当每个处理回归中该回归本身或影响函数调整中相应的Riesz表示子被正确设定时，该函数在模型误设的情况下仍然有效。所提出的框架不仅允许使用广泛的非参数和机器学习技术（包括LASSO、神经网络和随机森林）来估计考官工具变量，而且在适当的正则性条件下能够提供根号n一致的估计和有效的推断。
tldr: 本文提出了一种局部稳健的半参数框架，通过正交矩函数消除考官工具变量设计中估计误差的一阶效应，使得在协变量调整复杂的情况下可结合机器学习方法实现一致的估计和有效的推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a locally robust semiparametric framework for examiner IV designs, using an orthogonal moment function to eliminate first-order effects of estimation errors and enabling root-n consistent estimation and valid inference with nonparametric and machine learning methods.
